summary: The Crypto Company filed an 8-K to report a private placement of 24 million common shares to accredited investors for 0.74316232 BTC and $25,000 cash. The transaction is an unregistered sale under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b), not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisor is named. No price per share, premium, or closing date is specified. This is a routine capital-raising filing, not an acquisition, going-private, or other special-situation event. Watch for future dilution from prepaid warrants.
